s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful skin lesions with ulceration and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Painful pimple-like bumps on bilateral lower legs
Ulcers with central eschars and dusky gray borders
key_facts: Patient is a young black woman
Presented with chills and bilateral lower extremity swelling
Recent course of trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus
Medical history includes treatment with methimazole and atenolol
Laboratory tests show elevated CRP and ESR
Normal C3 and C4 complement levels
ANA titer 1:80
P-ANCA titer 1:20
Anti-myeloperoxidase (MPO) titer 141 U
Anti-SSA/Ro antibodies level 120 U
Punch biopsy shows mid- and deep dermal lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils and focal abscess
Second biopsy shows intraepidermal and dermal perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate with necrosis of vessel walls

raw.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful skin lesions with ulceration and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Painful pimple-like bumps on bilateral lower legs
Ulcers with central eschars and dusky gray borders
key_facts: Patient is a young black woman
Presented with chills and bilateral lower extremity swelling
Recent course of trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus
Medical history includes treatment with methimazole and atenolol
Laboratory tests show elevated CRP and ESR
Normal C3 and C4 complement levels
ANA titer 1:80
P-ANCA titer 1:20
Anti-myeloperoxidase (MPO) titer 141 U
Anti-SSA/Ro antibodies level 120 U
Punch biopsy shows mid- and deep dermal lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils and focal abscess
Second biopsy shows intraepidermal and dermal perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate with necrosis of vessel walls

shortlist.label: systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: elevated ANA titer and anti-SSA/Ro antibodies level, consistent with autoimmune disease

shortlist.label: vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: necrosis of vessel walls and perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate on biopsy, suggesting blood vessel inflammation

shortlist.label: pyoderma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: ulcerative skin lesions with central eschar and raised borders, consistent with this condition

shortlist.label: sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: non-caseating granulomas not seen, but lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on biopsy could suggest this diagnosis

shortlist.label: systemic vasculitis (e.g. granulomatosis with polyangiitis)
shortlist.why_kept: elevated anti-myeloperoxidase (MPO) titer and perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate, suggesting small vessel vasculitis

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with painful lesions, chills, and bilateral lower extremity swelling, along with laboratory results showing elevated CRP and ESR, and biopsy findings of necrosis of vessel walls and perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate, are consistent with vasculitis. The presence of anti-myeloperoxidase (MPO) antibodies also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: While the patient has a positive ANA titer, the clinical presentation and biopsy findings are more consistent with vasculitis than SLE.

rejected.label: pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: The patient's lesions are described as ulcers with central eschars and raised borders, but the biopsy findings and laboratory results are more suggestive of vasculitis.

rejected.label: sarcoidosis
rejected.why: There is no mention of granulomas or other characteristic findings of sarcoidosis in the biopsy results or clinical presentation.

rejected.label: systemic vasculitis (e.g. granulomatosis with polyangiitis)
rejected.why: While this is a type of vasculitis, the patient's presentation and biopsy findings are more consistent with a non-granulomatous vasculitis.
